name: Nuoc mam Nam O
summary: Nước mắm Nam Ô is a Da Nang specialty on the 16 Apr 2024 city page. The page calls it food, a seasoning, and a gift visitors take home. The 18 May 2020 page ties the same village to gỏi cá Nam Ô.
origin: Nam Ô, the fish-sauce village on the north shore toward Hải Vân.
culture: The 16 Apr 2024 page says Vietnamese visitors buy it for friends and family after a Da Nang trip. The English page of 29 Aug 2024 says the same.
howToEat: Use it as the seasoning, or carry a bottle home. The pages do not name a tasting counter.
where: Nam Ô. A shop door and an hour are not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Nuoc mam Nam O — Da Nang fish sauce
seoDescription: Nước mắm Nam Ô is food, a seasoning, and a gift on Da Nang’s 2024 specialty page. A shop door was not printed. Check on arrival.
